title: Moving a Window Contract to Another Series
content:
# Moving a Window Contract to Another Series

Estimating note for Window Replacement Contracts.

**Rule.** A contract may move to another product series, up or down, only before order release. A series change can be made only while the contract status is signed or measured. The re-priced contract price is the current contract price plus the difference between the new and the old series base price per opening times the current opening count, before any discount program; where the contract carries a discount program, the program rate of the new series is applied to the re-priced list price instead. Option lines already written stay at the price they were written at. A change into a series where exterior color is unavailable cannot be made while the contract carries an exterior color line. A series change made while the contract is measured carries the series redesign fee of the new series; one made while it is signed carries none. If the new series raises the required deposit, the difference is due before order release.

## Judgement table

| Contract status on record | Series change | Redesign fee |
|---|---|---|
| Signed | May be made | None |
| Measured | May be made | The new series' redesign fee |
| Ordered or later, or cancelled | Not made | — |

## Hypothetical re-pricing, no discount program

A contract at a hypothetical current price of $12,000 with 10 openings moves from a series at a hypothetical $1,000 per opening to one at a hypothetical $1,200 per opening. The re-priced contract price is $12,000 plus $200 times 10, that is $14,000. Option lines already written keep their written prices.
